name: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
title: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd - 500670 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 chemical realisations rose sequentially (6% to 28% product-wise) and TDI is running near 80%, but methanol and acetic acid volumes are constrained by gas costs and fertiliser losses persist pending urea cost and energy norm revisions.

utilisation.quote: So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

capex.peers_comment: Chinese aniline producers dump product; management says capacity not expanded because Chinese aniline is very cheap.
capex.quote: So that's why we have not enhanced our capacity because Chinese Aniline is very cheap.

triggers.label: Chemical realisations up 6-28% QoQ
triggers.quote: Product to product, but if you see the range, it is from 6% to 28%.

triggers.label: TDI operating near 80%
triggers.quote: So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

triggers.label: Methanol uneconomic at high gas prices
triggers.quote: the cost economics did not work out given the very high gas price.

triggers.label: Fertiliser urea under-recovery, no revision yet
triggers.quote: until the time norms are revised, both for fixed cost and energy, we see almost no chance in case of urea.

guidance.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

guidance.value: INR 10-12 crores per month once running; commissioning synchronisation third week of June 2026
guidance.quote: Our last estimate was to the tune of around INR10 crores to INR12 crores per month, which was the saving potential.
Board has in general declared a dividend of 210%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June.

red_flags.label: Fertiliser losses widening, urea revision pending
red_flags.quote: this is overdue as the losses are widening in case of Fertilizer segment.

red_flags.label: Large inter-corporate loans to PSU at 7.25%
red_flags.quote: So from INR565 crores, we have gone to roughly INR 2,400 crores.

red_flags.label: Management refused Q1 pricing and spread details
red_flags.quote: Q1, it's a price -sensitive information, we will not be able to provide such details.

evasions.topic: Q1/Q2 raw material cost roadmap and oil pricing
evasions.quote: on future, Q1, Q2, we are unable to exactly answer your question because that's a prognosis for the future and hard to make prediction.
Q1, it's a price -sensitive information, we will not be able to provide such details.
FY28, we would be in a position to tell in quarters coming
